holderQuote: They didn’t run. Eldertuin the Fortress planted his shield and bellowed a counter-command.
effectQuote: A pale, sage-green shield burst from his shield. It traced a teardrop shape—as wide as the street. The spells and Draugr hit it and—bounced.

holderQuote: It was Eldertuin the Fortress who lifted his mace and shield.
effectQuote: Eldertuin raised his shield as he charged.
